setup_wizard_desc: Pick a starting point. Shelves you already have are kept; nothing is removed.
setup_applied_toast: Setup applied — every shelf stays editable.
setup_pack_essential_desc: Favourites, recently played and recently added — the default trio.
setup_pack_steam_and_nonsteam_desc: Recently played, installed, your non-Steam shortcuts and favourites.
setup_pack_backlog_rescue_desc: Never played, a rotating backlog pick and the best games you haven't started.
setup_pack_portable_deck_desc: Installed and Deck Verified games, short-battery picks, travel-friendly titles and quick plays.
setup_pack_rediscover_desc: Most played, games you drifted away from, forgotten gems and hidden gems.
setup_pack_living_room_desc: Favourites and recent games with the full living-room look — hero art on every shelf, full-page shelves, the featured first game and logos — plus evening long sessions and Deck picks.
setup_pack_frame_desc: A light starting point for a headset: recent, favourites, quick plays and short-battery picks.
setup_pack_machine_desc: A TV starting point: favourites, recent and most played with hero art, evening sessions and Deck picks.
setup_pack_stream_desc: Games with cloud saves and recent play, so you can continue anywhere, plus quick plays.
showcase_final_title: How do you want to start?
showcase_final_body: Everything stays editable afterwards. You can reopen the setup wizard from the Quick Access menu at any time.
setup_nothing_to_add: You already have everything in this pack.
setup_done_body: Every shelf stays editable. To undo this setup later, open the wizard again from the wand icon in the Quick Access title bar.
